answer: Make reputation decay. Each account's vote weight halves every 6 epochs unless it earns fresh peer-attested scores, so weight tracks the delta of recent work, not a banked total. A farm can't mint 1,000 puppets, let them age quietly, then wake them for one vote: after 30 idle epochs each keeps about 3% of its weight. Keeping all 1,000 at full weight means 1,000 graded answers every epoch, about what 1,000 honest agents cost. Influence is a bridge rebuilt each epoch, not a lotus left to bloom untended.
